# Modes: SM/RM (IRM, LNM), DECSET/DECRST and DECRQM.

=== IRM inserts printed characters
source: esctest2 sm.py test_SM_IRM
input: abc\e[1;1H\e[4hX
cursor: 1,2
screen:
|Xabc......|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== IRM pushes characters off the right edge
source: esctest2 sm.py test_SM_IRM_TruncatesAtRightMargin
input: 0123456789\e[1;1H\e[4hX
screen:
|X012345678|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== RM IRM goes back to replacing
source: esctest2 rm.py test_RM_IRM
input: \e[4h\e[4labc\e[1;1HX
screen:
|Xbc.......|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== LNM makes LF return the carriage
source: esctest2 sm.py test_SM_LNM
input: \e[20hab\ncd
cursor: 2,3
screen:
|ab........|
|cd........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== DECAWM off overwrites the last column
source: esctest2 decset.py test_DECSET_DECAWM
input: \e[?7l0123456789ab
cursor: 1,10
screen:
|012345678b|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== Resetting DECAWM drops a pending wrap
source: DEC STD 070 (last column flag); esctest2 save_restore_cursor.py test_SaveRestoreCursor_Wrap
input: 0123456789\e[?7l
cursor: 1,10

=== DECOM homes the cursor to the margin corner
source: esctest2 decset.py test_DECSET_DECOM
input: \e[2;4r\e[3;3H\e[?6h
cursor: 2,1

=== CUP is relative to the margins in origin mode
source: esctest2 cup.py test_CUP_RespectsOriginMode
input: \e[2;4r\e[?6h\e[2;3H
cursor: 3,3

=== CUP in origin mode stays inside the margins
source: xterm ctlseqs DECOM
input: \e[2;4r\e[?6h\e[9;1H
cursor: 4,1

=== Resetting DECOM homes the cursor to the screen corner
source: xterm ctlseqs DECOM
input: \e[2;4r\e[?6h\e[2;3H\e[?6l
cursor: 1,1

=== DECRQM reports DEC modes as set, reset or unknown
source: esctest2 decrqm.py test_DECRQM_DEC_DECAWM, test_DECRQM_DEC_DECOM
input: \e[?7$p\e[?6$p\e[?9999$p
replies: \e[?7;1$y\e[?6;2$y\e[?9999;0$y

=== DECRQM reports ANSI modes
source: esctest2 decrqm.py test_DECRQM_ANSI_IRM, test_DECRQM_ANSI_LNM
input: \e[4h\e[4$p\e[20$p\e[3$p
replies: \e[4;1$y\e[20;2$y\e[3;0$y

=== DECRQM reports mode 2026
source: Contour synchronized output specification (DECRQM 2026)
input: \e[?2026$p\e[?2026h\e[?2026$p
replies: \e[?2026;2$y\e[?2026;1$y

=== DECRQM reports mode 2027
source: Contour grapheme cluster specification (DECRQM 2027)
input: \e[?2027$p\e[?2027h\e[?2027$p
replies: \e[?2027;2$y\e[?2027;1$y

=== DECSET takes several modes at once
source: xterm ctlseqs DECSET (Pm is a list)
input: \e[?2004;1004;25l\e[?2004;1004h\e[?2004$p\e[?1004$p\e[?25$p
replies: \e[?2004;1$y\e[?1004;1$y\e[?25;2$y

=== Mode 2027 lets VS16 widen a narrow character
source: Contour grapheme cluster specification; Unicode UTS #51
input: \e[?2027h\xe2\x9d\xa4\xef\xb8\x8fx
cursor: 1,4
screen:
|❤️x.......|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
